newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico confirms arrest of Gulf drugs cartel boss.
newsitem.headline: Mexico confirms arrest of Gulf drugs cartel boss.

text.p: Mexican police have arrested Oscar Malherbe de Leon, the acting head of the Gulf drugs cartel, authorities said on Thursday.

"The arrest has been achieved of Oscar Malherbe de Leon, who, since the arrest of Juan Garcia Abrego, has been at the head of the drug-trafficking operations of the so-called Gulf Cartel," the Attorney General's Office said in a statement.
Malherbe tried and failed to buy his release by offering a $2 million bribe to the arresting officers, the statement said.
It gave no details of when or where Malherbe was captured.

Garcia was arrested in January last year and is now serving a life sentence without parole in a U.S. prison after being found guilty in a Houston court of shipping millions of dollars worth of cocaine into the United States.
The Attorney General's Office said the arrest of Malherbe was a joint operation between police and the Defense Ministry.
